LESSON: COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.5: Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. enjoy talking about a enjoyment text they have read.  Learners can track text using their fingers

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Comprehension for Grade 2 ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. enjoy talking about a enjoyment text they have read.  Learners can track text using their fingers
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Comprehension above.
2. Explain Comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Comprehension important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. enjoy talking about a enjoyment text they have read.  Learners can track text using their fingers

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
